title: Peppermint Reindeer Cupcakes
description: These cupcakes filled with peppermint ice cream are decorated with candies to look like really cute reindeer.
ingredients: 4 (2 ounce) Cake, snack cakes, cupcakes, chocolate, with frosting, low-fat
1 tablespoon mini candy-coated milk chocolate (such as M&M's®)
4 Hershey Y & S Nibs Cherry Candy-Pkg HER

steps.text: Remove paper liners from cupcakes. Cut in half crosswise; set bottom aside. Decorate the tops with candies for the 'eyes' and 'mouth'. Add sour cherry balls for the 'nose'. Break pretzels in half for 'antlers'.
Spread 1 tablespoon ice cream over the bottom of each cupcake. Place decorated halves on top. Serve immediately or freeze for several hours before serving.
